name: The Girlfriend Experience
description: Explore the relationships between exclusive escorts and their clients, for whom they provide far more than just sex. Known as GFEs, they are women who provide “The Girlfriend Experience”—emotional and sexual relationships at a very high price.

videos.title: Entry
videos.overview: A Chicago law-school student's life takes a dramatic turn when a classmate introduces her to the world of transactional relationships.

videos.title: A Friend
videos.overview: Christine's double life begins, as she balances her pursuit of a legal career with her work as a girlfriend experience.

videos.title: Retention
videos.overview: Christine confronts Jacqueline over the level of her control; David needs Erin's help to retain one of the firm's major clients.

videos.title: Crossing the Line
videos.overview: Christine juggles the demands of law school, her internship and her expanding list of GFE clients; Christine observes trouble among the Kirkland partners at David's annual party.

videos.title: Insurance
videos.overview: Christine's secret identity is compromised following the death of one of her clients.

videos.title: Boundaries
videos.overview: Christine's growing intimacy with a new client threatens to cross business boundaries; David is confirmed as managing partner at Kirkland & Allen.

videos.title: Access
videos.overview: Christine attempts to prevent any further intrusions from Jack, but encounters another problem from an unexpected source.

videos.title: Provocation
videos.overview: Christine goes on the attack at Kirkland, intent on achieving revenge.

videos.title: Blindsided
videos.overview: Christine's worlds collide, forcing her to devise a way to come out on top.

videos.title: Available
videos.overview: Christine embraces her career as a GFE provider following her humiliating experience at Kirkland.

videos.title: Fabrication
videos.overview: Christine goes on the counter-attack, in an attempt to force a settlement with Kirkland & Allen, while exploring more anonymous ways to service her GFE clients.

videos.title: Home
videos.overview: Christine travels home for her parent's 30th wedding anniversary party. They are partially happy to see her.

videos.title: Separation
videos.overview: Christine is in complete control.

videos.title: Erica & Anna: Leverage
videos.overview: Erica Myles, the finance director at Right To Action, a Republican super PAC, enlists the help of an escort, Anna Garner, in an attempt to gain access to a secret, dark money donor network.

videos.title: Bria: Admitting
videos.overview: Bria Jones, a former GFE, enters the witness protection program in order to escape an abusive relationship. When she is relocated to a small town in New Mexico, she finds the GFE world beckoning her once again.

videos.title: Erica & Anna: The List
videos.overview: Anna delivers a piece of incriminating evidence against Novak, while her relationship with Erica becomes personal. Erica is contacted by a powerful financier.

videos.title: Bria: Eggshells
videos.overview: Despite orders to lay low, Bria meets a new client, triggering Ian's suspicions.

videos.title: Erica & Anna: Solicitation
videos.overview: Erica lands her biggest donor yet while Anna and Erica's relationship intensifies.

videos.title: Bria: Negotiation
videos.overview: Bria expands the boundaries of the GFE in order to have her needs met.

videos.title: Erica & Anna: Donors
videos.overview: Erica gets a suspicious call from a representative of a secretive potential donor. Anna subjugates herself to Erica's sexual desires and makes a startling decision to solidify their personal relationship.

videos.title: Bria: Moral Inventory
videos.overview: With an impending trial date, Ian attempts to reign in Bria by stepping up his surveillance of her.

videos.title: Erica & Anna: Family
videos.overview: Anna breaks some big news to Erica and Erica begins to feel increasing pressure at work.

videos.title: Bria: Living Like a Tornado
videos.overview: Bria takes matters into her own hands in order to escape Ian.

videos.title: Erica & Anna: Citizens First
videos.overview: After her rejection from Erica, Anna looks for answers while Erica's life takes unexpected turns, with potentially devastating consequences.

videos.title: Bria: Making Amends
videos.overview: The day of the trial has arrived, and Bria must reckon with facing Donald head-on.

videos.title: Erica & Anna: Free Fall
videos.overview: Erica tries to escape the consequences of her professional and personal decisions as she falls into a downward spiral, while Anna finds herself back at the top of her game.

videos.title: Bria: Relapse
videos.overview: Pursued by both the law and Donald, Bria is forced to take matters into her own hands.

videos.title: Mirrors
videos.overview: Iris relocates to London, leaving behind family and a half-finished degree. She begins a double life: working at an elusive tech startup while providing the girlfriend experience at night.

videos.title: Everyone's Got a Price
videos.overview: Iris and her co-worker start working on an AI project that mirrors human emotion. Meanwhile, new clients provided by a high-end escort agency, leave Iris with a wealth of behavioral data.

videos.title: Deepfake
videos.overview: Iris gets better at simulating the perfect girlfriend experience for her clients. Simultaneously at NGM, Iris and her co-workers start training the AI model with new simulated sets.

videos.title: Shuffle
videos.overview: Iris' client relationships seem increasingly uncanny, and advice from Tawny isn't what Iris was hoping for. Her father's illness catches up with Iris in undeniable ways.

videos.title: Control Shift
videos.overview: Iris can't keep her two worlds separate anymore, which comes with unwanted consequences. Iris realizes she's in a position of power, while simultaneously having lost all control.

videos.title: The Embrace
videos.overview: Buying time, Iris escapes the messy leftovers of her double life and takes time off-grid. Georges, a former client, takes Iris into his world. Reality, however, has a way of catching up.

videos.title: Black Box
videos.overview: Cassie is back with a vengeance, taking her work to the next level. Iris' secrecy around the project puts a dent in her relationship with Hiram and their collaboration around Emcee.

videos.title: A Set of Lies Agreed Upon
videos.overview: Having family in town brings up complicated feelings for Iris. Tawny feels bad about how things played out with The V. Afraid to face her own truth, Iris realizes she needs to switch gears.

videos.title: State of Mind
videos.overview: Having lost all sense of perspective, Iris confides in Christophe, who, in turn, opens up a part of his world. Little does Iris know the encounter will leave her shaken to the core.

videos.title: Integration
videos.overview: Struggling to recover from betrayal, Iris is willing to take a radical leap once again. Iris needs to confront one more person before making a fateful decision: Emcee.
